purpose: Source-first, non-runtime classical-operator and temporal-scale research. This ledger records what the named witnesses establish, what remains unknown, and one bounded next experiment. It does not create a market model.

controllingWitnesses.r6Inspection: These PDF pages were inspected as page images during R6; the ledger does not treat OCR as controlling evidence.

controllingWitnesses.r6Use: Existing exact source contracts and cross-text matrix only; no witness is collapsed into Trailokya.

founderEmpiricalHypotheses.statement: Longer-duration aspects may define broader market regimes whose relevant movement is concentrated substantially within their geometric interval.
Short-duration aspects may produce movement visible during their interval on a low timeframe while appearing as continuation on a higher timeframe.
Apparent post-event continuation may depend on whether another material astronomical event follows immediately.
Multiple overlapping events may be more informative when visualized by temporal scale than when prematurely summed into one scalar.

evidenceClassificationVocabulary.SOURCE_EXPLICIT: The named source directly states the bounded rule or category at the recorded locator.
evidenceClassificationVocabulary.SOURCE_IMPLIED: A limited consequence follows from an explicit source statement, but is not a separately stated formula or universal rule.
evidenceClassificationVocabulary.COMMENTARY: A commentary reading is retained as commentary and does not override a named root or controlling witness.
evidenceClassificationVocabulary.LATER_INTERPRETATION: A later interpretation is retained as a distinct witness layer, never promoted to source-root authority.
evidenceClassificationVocabulary.ENGINEERING_MAPPING: A deterministic research or display mapping with no claim of classical authority.
evidenceClassificationVocabulary.SOURCE_SILENT: The inspected and admitted sources do not establish the requested rule. This is a valid fail-closed finding.
evidenceClassificationVocabulary.UNRESOLVED: Evidence exists but does not close the dependency because a definition, composition order, scope, or worked reproduction is absent.

candidateExperiments.question: Can one isolated source-profiled categorical context be connected to a preregistered market-polarity bridge?
candidateExperiments.reasonNotRecommended: The source does not supply the currency/market polarity bridge; choosing one now would be a new hypothesis rather than source closure.

candidateExperiments.question: Does the independently computed geometric duration D_i improve a separately preregistered temporal-scale partition?
candidateExperiments.reasonNotRecommended: D_i is computable but its causal or magnitude meaning is not classical; it should not be the first post-S4 market-facing experiment.

candidateExperiments.question: Can two isolated implementations reproduce source-closed categorical annotations for a fresh frozen event population while preserving UNKNOWN for every unclosed dependency?
candidateExperiments.reasonRecommended: It is independent of S4 results, computable, falsifiable, high-information for the next market-design gate, and avoids both source-profile pooling and double counting.

futurePreregistrationSkeleton.researchQuestion: Do independently implemented source-closed components and abstention rules reproduce exactly on a fresh, frozen event population?

evaluatorIndependence.evaluatorA: A separate implementation with an independently frozen source hash; it must not import Evaluator B code, business logic, helpers, or expected-output fixtures.
evaluatorIndependence.evaluatorB: A separate implementation with an independently frozen source hash; it must not import Evaluator A code, business logic, helpers, or expected-output fixtures.
sharedOnly: immutable source packet and contract identities
notShared: expected outputs generated by either evaluator
freezeBeforeExecution: Evaluator A implementation identity and source hash
Evaluator B implementation identity and source hash
both implementation identities must be frozen before either output is inspected
evaluatorIndependence.mismatchPolicy: Any mismatch fails the frozen run. Do not patch either evaluator after a discrepancy and continue the same run; source adjudication or implementation correction requires a new preregistered run.
evaluatorIndependence.interpretationBoundary: Agreement tests deterministic implementation reproducibility of already source-certified contracts. It does not independently prove the historical truth of the underlying interpretation beyond the accepted source packets and does not validate market prediction.

futurePreregistrationSkeleton.populationFreezeTiming: All population fields must be frozen before either evaluator is written or executed.
futurePreregistrationSkeleton.populationSelectionBoundary: Population selection must not use S4 success or failure rows, market outcomes, or any result-derived criterion.

mayReproduce: literal individual source records and their stated conditions
candidateCScope.verse166Policy: If included, verse-166 records remain individual source-certified conditions only; no multi-condition composition is allowed.

futurePreregistrationSkeleton.population: All distinct event identities emitted by a separately frozen event-compiler version within a future fixed UTC interval; no S4 identities are reused for selection or tuning.
admittedComponents: natural planet class with source-bounded Moon and Mercury conditions
temporary and compound relationship under their own cross-text contract
ordinary and special Drsti geometry under their own source contract
Sthula motion category when a source-defined category is determinable
futurePreregistrationSkeleton.unknownAndExclusionPolicy: Any missing input, unsupported context, stationary/direct-slow condition, unclosed precedence, or unclosed timing rule is UNKNOWN and is reported rather than imputed, neutralized, or removed after inspection.
futurePreregistrationSkeleton.eventBoundaryRule: Use exact UTC identities and half-open geometric intervals supplied by the independently frozen event compiler. These boundaries are engineering geometry, not source-defined efficacy windows.
futurePreregistrationSkeleton.signRuleBoundary: No market direction, currency polarity, or classical-to-FX bridge is tested.
futurePreregistrationSkeleton.magnitudeRuleBoundary: No source measurements are summed, stacked, normalized, or translated to market magnitude.
futurePreregistrationSkeleton.requiredData: Frozen astronomical inputs, source packet identifiers, implementation outputs, unknown reasons, and reproducibility hashes only. No price, return, trade, execution, or outcome field is permitted.
futurePreregistrationSkeleton.primaryEndpoint: Exact per-field agreement between the two independently built evaluators, plus exact agreement on required UNKNOWN outcomes.
futurePreregistrationSkeleton.failureCondition: Any disagreement on a declared source-closed field, any unlicensed fallback, or any mandatory UNKNOWN converted into a value fails the frozen run.
futurePreregistrationSkeleton.passCriterion: Zero discrepancies across all preregistered source-closed output fields and mandatory UNKNOWN decisions.
futurePreregistrationSkeleton.falsificationRule: Any disagreement on a declared source-closed field, any unlicensed fallback, or any UNKNOWN silently converted to a value fails the experiment; no post hoc adjudication may change the frozen run.
futurePreregistrationSkeleton.statistics: Report all-record exact agreement and the complete discrepancy ledger. There is no p-value and no averaging of discrepancies.
futurePreregistrationSkeleton.multipleTesting: No pooled score or omnibus market test. Report each profile and component family separately; discrepancies are not averaged away.
futurePreregistrationSkeleton.stoppingRule: Fixed population and fixed evaluator versions. A failed run is closed; expansion, source adjudication, or a new population requires a new preregistration.

productImplications.IMPLEMENTABLE_SOURCE_CERTIFIED: Read-only, source-profiled provenance and categorical annotation display with literal locator and UNKNOWN state.
productImplications.IMPLEMENTABLE_EXPERIMENTAL: A separately versioned research-only D_i temporal-scale label, never a strength, amplitude, or predictive signal.
productImplications.RESEARCH_ONLY: The recommended independent source-operator reproduction experiment and any future source-to-market bridge hypothesis.
productImplications.BLOCKED_BY_SOURCE: Application/separation efficacy, duration/persistence/decay, nested-wave composition, universal precedence, universal cancellation, and any market bridge.
productImplications.BLOCKED_BY_EMPIRICAL_VALIDATION: Any market-facing claim even if a future bridge is explicitly preregistered.
